description: Source code for the SMSCenter class in the ERPNext system, handling SMS recipient list creation and message sending.

classes.name: SMSCenter
classes.description: A class representing an SMS center for managing and sending SMS messages within ERPNext.

methods.name: create_receiver_list
methods.description: Creates a list of receiver contact details based on the specified criteria.

methods.name: get_receiver_nos
methods.description: Extracts and returns a list of receiver phone numbers from the receiver list.

methods.name: send_sms
methods.description: Sends an SMS message to the list of receiver phone numbers.
